'''Hiit''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Hiitian/Legends|Hiitians]], who made first contact with the off-world [[Trianii Rangers]] at some point by around [[1500 BBY]]. In [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], the Hiit was annexed by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].

==Description==
Hiit was a desolate<ref name="TEA" /> terrestrial<ref name="Terrestrial" /> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maal]]. It was situated in the [[Hiit system/Legends|Hiit system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], and lay at the intersection of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as the [[Authority Guardian Corridor]] and the [[Trianii Shunt]], which connected it to the [[Atchorb system/Legends|Atchorb]] and [[Ninn system/Legends|Ninn systems]] and the [[Fibuli system/Legends|Fibuli]] and [[Lythos system/Legends|Lythos systems]], respectively.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
At some point by approximately [[1500 BBY]], the [[Hiitian/Legends|Hiitian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of Hiit made first contact with the [[Trianii Rangers]] of the off-world [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] species, after which millions of the moon's natives eventually traveled into the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Although the first contact was peaceful,<ref name="TEA" /> at some point before the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Hiitian raider group known as the [[Hiitite Ravagers]] was formed, going on to engage in conflicts against the Trianii Rangers.<ref name="GaW" /> The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] annexed Hiit in [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], with the Hiitians consequently having warily hostile attitudes toward that government.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Hiitian/Legends}}
Hiit was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] Hiitian species,<ref name="TEA" /> members of which were also known as the Hiit.<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Hiit was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-3.<ref name="TEA" />
